services.title: LLM & Generative AI Applications
services.summary: Custom LLM features that automate real workflows - document generation, summarisation, transcription and structured data extraction.
bullets: Multi-step LLM pipelines with OpenAI, Gemini, Amazon Bedrock and open-weight models (gpt-oss, Llama, Qwen)
Speech-to-text workflows that turn conversations into structured documents
Privacy-first design, including local PII de-identification

proof.text: Production LLM features for a UK healthcare software company

services.title: RAG Systems & AI Knowledge Assistants
services.summary: Assistants that answer accurately from your own documents, manuals or knowledge base.
bullets: Semantic and hybrid search with embeddings, vector databases and BM25
Cross-encoder reranking, conversation memory and response caching
Measured retrieval and answer quality (Recall@K, MRR, nDCG, RAGAS)

services.title: Prompt Optimization & LLM Evaluation
services.summary: For AI features that work "most of the time" - I make them accurate, consistent and cheaper to run.
bullets: Systematic evaluation with test cases and repeated-run accuracy checks
Prompt and context engineering to cut tokens, latency and API cost
Reliability fixes for rate limits, failures and inconsistent outputs

services.title: Machine Learning Model Development
services.summary: Predictive models for tabular data, text and images, built and validated properly.
bullets: Classification and prediction with Scikit-learn, XGBoost and PyTorch
NLP and computer vision, including fine-tuned YOLOv8 detection
Feature engineering, tuning and experiment tracking with MLflow and DVC

services.title: Backend APIs & Cloud Deployment
services.summary: Getting AI and web applications live, secure and maintainable.
bullets: REST APIs with FastAPI and Django on PostgreSQL
Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD and AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Lightsail)
React + TypeScript frontends when a complete product is needed

services.title: Data Collection & Processing Pipelines
services.summary: Clean, usable data for analytics and machine learning.
bullets: Web scraping with Scrapy, Selenium and BeautifulSoup
Large-scale processing with PySpark and Pandas
Graph analysis with Neo4j and NetworkX

services.title: Web & Mobile Applications
services.summary: Full-stack web apps and cross-platform Flutter mobile apps, from first design to release.
bullets: Web apps with React + TypeScript on Django, FastAPI or Spring Boot backends
Cross-platform Flutter apps with offline-first local storage and scheduled notifications
Production delivery with Docker, CI/CD and cloud hosting

proof.text: TR Ledger Flutter app and the University of Peradeniya EEU web platform

process.text: A short call to scope the problem and define what success looks like.
A quick working version to validate the approach.
Measure accuracy and performance against real test cases.
Deploy to production with monitoring and documentation.
